description: This file defines the AppState class, which manages application-level initialization and status flags for a Flutter app, including database initialization and error reporting.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Manages app initialization state, flags for readiness, loading, and error reporting, and handles asynchronous database setup.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the database asynchronously, handles errors, and updates state flags accordingly.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Private method to update the _isLoading flag and notify listeners.

methods.name: _setReady
methods.description: Private method to update the _isReady flag and notify listeners.
